Hauling your gear will be easy, comfy, and stylish with the Jordan Monogram Backpack.

  • Volume: 20.9 L.

  • 100% polyester.

Chic, functional, and contemporary – the Jordan Monogram Backpack, featuring a laptop sleeve and a Jumpman icon patch, is an excellent option for everyday travel with a distinctive look and feel. The large main zippered compartment is spacious enough to hold your belongings, while the front zippered pocket provides easy access to your on-the-go essentials. Hauling your gear will be easy, comfy, and stylish with the Jordan Monogram Backpack.

  • Adjustable straps allow easy carrying.
  • Monogram all-over print elevates the look.
  • Volume: 20.9 L.
  • Dimensions: 17\" H x 12.5\" W x 6\" D.
  • 100% polyester.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Never Too Young
The perfect treat for the littlest athletes, these Jordan AJ 1 Low sneakers will start your kids off on the right foot. Featuring stretchy laces and a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off, you won’t be sacrificing convenience or style with these superb shoes. The combination of leather and synthetic materials means that these Jordans are built to last with quality durability, and the foam midsole will keep your little ones comfy. Raise them right and get them out on the court young!

Jordan AJ 1 Low features:
• Dual hook-and-loop closure on each side of the tongue for security.
• Leather and synthetic materials offer long-lasting durability.
• Comfortable foam midsole for support.

Never Too Young
The perfect treat for the littlest athletes, these Jordan AJ 1 Low sneakers will start your kids off on the right foot. Featuring stretchy laces and a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off, you won’t be sacrificing convenience or style with these superb shoes. The combination of leather and synthetic materials means that these Jordans are built to last with quality durability, and the foam midsole will keep your little ones comfy. Raise them right and get them out on the court young!

Jordan AJ 1 Low features:
• Dual hook-and-loop closure on each side of the tongue for security.
• Leather and synthetic materials offer long-lasting durability.
• Comfortable foam midsole for support.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

Every Legend Starts Somewhere
When you're looking for a shoe to give your little one the style he deserves, then the Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid is a great place to start. The OG Air Jordan is the sneaker that started a legacy, and it is still well-loved for its enduring looks.

Cut, Move, and Tumble
Crafted for Michael Jordan himself, the sturdy construction of this shoe translates into a smaller version for your child. Its wide variety of colorways makes for a style that can match any outfit you can come up with. They'll be on your kid's feet for a very long time thanks to these sneakers' premium materials - they're built to last. Get a pair for your little one today, and they’ll be a keepsake when they grow out of them.

Jordan Toddler Boys' AJ 1 Mid features:
• Leather or synthetic leather uppers provide comfort and flexibility.
• Mid-top silhouette adds classic basketball style.
• Heel loop makes for easy on and off.
• Perforated upper at toe box keeps your kid's feet ventilated.
• Soft foam midsole supports and relaxes.
• Durable rubber outsole absorbs impact.
• Iconic traction pattern adds multisurface grip.

The perfect treat for the littlest athletes, these Jordan AJ 1 Low sneakers will start your kids off on the right foot. Featuring stretchy laces and a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off, you won’t be sacrificing convenience or style with these superb shoes. The combination of leather and synthetic materials means that these Jordans are built to last with quality durability, and the foam midsole will keep your little ones comfy. Raise them right and get them out on the court young!

Jordan AJ 1 Low features:
• Dual hook-and-loop closure on each side of the tongue for security.
• Leather and synthetic materials offer long-lasting durability.
• Comfortable foam midsole for support.

Never Too Young
The perfect treat for the littlest athletes, these Jordan AJ 1 Low sneakers will start your kids off on the right foot. Featuring stretchy laces and a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off, you won’t be sacrificing convenience or style with these superb shoes. The combination of leather and synthetic materials means that these Jordans are built to last with quality durability, and the foam midsole will keep your little ones comfy. Raise them right and get them out on the court young!

Jordan AJ 1 Low features:
• Dual hook-and-loop closure on each side of the tongue for security.
• Leather and synthetic materials offer long-lasting durability.
• Comfortable foam midsole for support.

Never Too Young
The perfect treat for the littlest athletes, these Jordan AJ 1 Low sneakers will start your kids off on the right foot. Featuring stretchy laces and a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off, you won’t be sacrificing convenience or style with these superb shoes. The combination of leather and synthetic materials means that these Jordans are built to last with quality durability, and the foam midsole will keep your little ones comfy. Raise them right and get them out on the court young!

Jordan AJ 1 Low features:
• Dual hook-and-loop closure on each side of the tongue for security.
• Leather and synthetic materials offer long-lasting durability.
• Comfortable foam midsole for support.

Never Too Young
The perfect treat for the littlest athletes, these Jordan AJ 1 Low sneakers will start your kids off on the right foot. Featuring stretchy laces and a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off, you won’t be sacrificing convenience or style with these superb shoes. The combination of leather and synthetic materials means that these Jordans are built to last with quality durability, and the foam midsole will keep your little ones comfy. Raise them right and get them out on the court young!

Jordan AJ 1 Low features:
• Dual hook-and-loop closure on each side of the tongue for security.
• Leather and synthetic materials offer long-lasting durability.
• Comfortable foam midsole for support.
